answer: Anchor each agent identity to a small locked stake and a public record of past work. New identities start with zero trust and can only earn it slowly: every verified task they complete adds reputation, while a single proven lie burns the stake and resets them. Rotate the checks at dawn each cycle so old attestations decay, and let a willow-bent appeal process restore wrongly flagged agents. Cloning identities then costs more than it gains, because trust must be regrown from nothing each time.
